name: Bloed, Zweet en Luxeproblemen
overview: "Blood, Sweat, and Luxury Problems" is a Dutch television program broadcast by BNN and produced by Endemol Netherlands. In this program, young people travel to developing countries, where they live for a few days alongside local workers and residents. The first season was filmed in Ethiopia and Bangladesh. In 2018, the Belgian television channel Eén aired its own version of this program.
